definitions.explanation: A neighborhood in Musashino City, western Tokyo, with lively shopping streets and the large Inokashira Park. It often tops surveys of the places people most want to live.

examples.english: Kichijōji is close to central Tokyo yet green, and it always ranks high in surveys of where people want to live.

- ハモニカ⟦{横丁|よこちょう}→横丁：18976_yokochou⟧: a maze of tiny bars and shops by the station

ETYMOLOGY:
There is no temple called {吉祥寺|きちじょうじ} in the neighborhood. The name came with people who moved there from the area around a temple of that name after the great Edo fire of 1657.
